basics.name: Valkenburgh Margin
basics.label: Full-Stack Developer | Computer Engineering Graduate
basics.summary: Computer Engineering graduate with hands-on experience building and deploying full-stack web applications. Proficient in React, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL. Strong foundation in RESTful API development, database design, and cloud deployment. Seeking a Full-Stack Developer position to contribute to innovative projects.

projects.name: Multi-Tenant Asset Manager
projects.description: Production-ready asset management system with multi-tenant architecture ensuring complete data isolation between organizations
highlights: Developed production-ready asset management system with multi-tenant architecture ensuring complete data isolation between organizations
Implemented secure JWT authentication with bcrypt password hashing and input validation
Built RESTful API with Express.js handling CRUD operations for assets with organization-level security
Designed PostgreSQL database schema using Prisma ORM with proper relationships and constraints
Created responsive React UI with Tailwind CSS and modern component architecture
Deployed backend to Railway and frontend to Vercel with environment configuration
Utilized Supabase for PostgreSQL database hosting and management

projects.name: Enterprise Task Management System
projects.description: Full-stack productivity application with user authentication and task management
highlights: Built full-stack productivity application with user authentication and task management
Implemented persistent data storage with PostgreSQL and relational database design
Developed responsive React frontend with modern UI/UX patterns
Deployed application to Vercel with Supabase backend integration
